description: Both generals on column 4 (e-file) with nothing between them - the simplest possible bikjang position. Bikjang alone never ends the game: under kja (Fairy-Stockfish janggi) the opponent must break it or pass, and only bikjang standing for a second position ends the game on points (see tests/rules/game-result.test.ts). Under modern, bikjang is ignored entirely.
